scope: Read-only Win10/x64 object-directory access checks,not native worker qualification
basis: twelfth-loader-trace.json proves failure in KERNELBASE initialization before Python or USER32 modules load; privilege-filtered own-token baseline starts
method: A fixed standard-user observer derives baseline and exact-user write-restricted tokens,verifies actual thread impersonation,and opens six fixed existing kernel object directories with five declared access masks:3,7,15,0x20003,0x2000f. The read/control combination permits observing a DACL without requiring create permission. Collect exact NTSTATUS and available DACLs. Opening for create permission does not create an object.
mutations_excluded: No object creation or DACL change in Windows namespaces
No registry or runtime image change
No broad restricting SID or policy privilege grant
No filesystem write outside capped observation output
